name: Lisa Criscitello
public_footprint:
Lisa Criscitello works in the New York State Assembly as a constituent liaison/legislative director in Assemblyman Walczyk's office, which covers St. Lawrence County. She is listed in county Board of Health meeting minutes as representing Assemblyman Walczyk's office, and was quoted as a Potsdam resident in a 2014 North Country Public Radio story.
Sources: https://opengovpay.com/ny/louis-lanzillotta-a/124172197; https://www.northcountrypublicradio.org/news/story/24697/owens-endorses-and-campaigns-with-aaron-woolf-in-ny21-race
